<div class="card-body">
'''Shistavanen Wolfman''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] ([[Alien]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">シスタヴァネン・ウルフマン</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">リアクションとして隣接する位置カードへ移動してよい。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-30o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ラック・シブラックはシスタヴァネン男性の典型といえる。凶暴だが攻撃的ではない。よく偵察兵として帝国アカデミーで訓練を受けているが、皇帝の勅令をいぶかしんでいる。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Shistavanen Wolfman.

'''Card text:''' May move to an adjacent site as a react.

'''Lore:''' Lak Sivrak is a typical Shistavanen male. Ferocious, but not aggressive. Often trained as a scout at Imperial academies, and doubts the Emperor's edicts.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Shistavanen Wolfman]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 100. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
